description: AI-powered business automation platform. Chat widget captures leads, books appointments, and automates follow-ups for small businesses.

directory_map.frontend/public/widget/: Widget mirror (must be identical to widget/)

critical_rules: NEVER use `from __future__ import annotations` in any Python file — it breaks FastAPI Pydantic model resolution
Always use `client_id` (not `tenant_id`) when querying the `leads` table
Always use `client_id` (not `tenant_id`) when querying the `conversations` table
Always use `status` (not `lead_stage`) for lead status in the `leads` table
Widget JS in widget/ and frontend/public/widget/ must be identical
Database schema changes ONLY via numbered migration files in migrations/
NEVER commit .env files or log secret values
Production runs with 4 Uvicorn workers — in-memory state is per-process only
Current plan names: free, growth, professional, autopilot, enterprise
Valid Claude API model IDs: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

agents.description: Specialized AI roles for delegated work. Each agent has deep domain knowledge.
agents.format: Markdown with YAML frontmatter (name, description, tools)

available.name: schema-guardian
available.purpose: Database schema expert. Use BEFORE any database work.

available.name: backend-dev
available.purpose: FastAPI backend specialist. API endpoints, Pydantic models, Supabase queries, Stripe.

available.name: frontend-dev
available.purpose: React/Vite frontend specialist. Dashboard pages, components, UI styling.

available.name: widget-specialist
available.purpose: Chat widget expert. Widget behavior, CORS, embedding, chat flow.

available.name: qa-tester
available.purpose: Quality assurance. Validates changes, checks for bugs, regressions, edge cases.

available.name: devops
available.purpose: Deployment and infrastructure. CI/CD, Railway, Vercel, environment variables.

skills.description: Reusable knowledge modules that encode domain expertise and workflows.
skills.format: Markdown with YAML frontmatter (name, description) in SKILL.md files

available.name: schema-guard
available.trigger: Before writing any database query, migration, or Pydantic model

available.name: debug-api
available.trigger: When diagnosing API errors (422s, 500s, CORS, silent data loss)

available.name: migration-workflow
available.trigger: When creating, applying, or verifying database migrations

available.name: ai-feature-pattern
available.trigger: When building features that call the Claude API

available.name: team-orchestration
available.trigger: When a task benefits from delegating to multiple agents

available.name: industry-content
available.trigger: When adding support for a new business type/industry

available.name: widget-test
available.trigger: When testing or modifying the chat widget

available.name: agentnexlify-surface-selector
available.trigger: Choose the correct surface/subsystem before editing

available.name: agentnexlify-runtime-constraints
available.trigger: Account for multi-worker runtime behavior and in-memory limits

available.name: agentnexlify-widget-integrity
available.trigger: Preserve production widget contract and mirrored assets

available.name: llm-council
available.trigger: Complex decisions with real stakes — 'council this', 'pressure-test this'
